description: This file defines the AggregateError class that extends Error, used to handle multiple errors collectively. It declares the class, its constructor, properties, and iteration capabilities.

classes.name: AggregateError
classes.description: A class that aggregates multiple Error instances and implements iterable to traverse individual errors.

methods.name: constructor(errors: ReadonlyArray<T | {[key: string]: any} | string>); constructor
methods.description: Initializes an AggregateError with an array of errors, which can be Error objects, strings, or objects with properties.

methods.name: [Symbol.iterator]
methods.description: Returns an iterator to traverse the individual errors contained within the AggregateError.

ctags.name: AggregateError
ctags.pattern: /^declare class AggregateError<T extends Error = Error> extends Error implements Iterable<T> {$/
